title: Wynncraft: The Faded Court
description: A Wynncraft modpack featuring a highly customized UI and loading screens, immersive audio-visual enhancements, and top-tier performance optimizations.
body:
Welcome to the ultimate, heavily optimized Wynncraft client. Built to deliver a seamless, immersive, and visually stunning RPG experience, this pack combines top-tier performance optimizations with deep audio-visual enhancements and essential server utilities. 

---

### 🌟 Current Theme: The Faded Court (V1)
*Every major Wynncraft expansion brings a completely new look. This version's theme is inspired by the closed walls and imperial elegance of the Fruma province.*

* **Custom Main Menu:** Features an exclusive "Faded Court" main menu layout with custom buttons and framing designed specifically to match the elegant, imperial aesthetic of the province.
  
  ![Custom Wynncraft Themed Title Page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4fbdf1653d21066c3946e01576642e589e24ddd.jpeg)
  
* **Themed Loading Screens:** Immersive custom loading backgrounds when launching the game and transitioning into the server.

  ![Custom Wynncraft Loading Screen Featuring a blurred background image and tips](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fe6b3f44f82c721b59bfec3718e21e17c95eda2.jpeg)
* **Personalized Details:** Includes a custom cursor and unique window title/icon designed to seamlessly blend with Wynncraft's overarching atmosphere.

---

### 🚀 Extreme Performance
Built on a foundation of the best Fabric optimization tools available to keep your frames high in crowded areas like Detlas.
* **High Framerates:** Sodium, Lithium, and Entity Culling work together to maintain stable FPS by stopping the game from rendering things you can't see.
* **Memory Efficiency:** FerriteCore and ModernFix drastically reduce RAM usage, micro-stutters, and world-load times.
* **Massive Render Distances:** Voxy and WynnLODGrabber allow you to see sprawling landscapes with lightweight Level of Detail (LOD) generation.

### 🎨 Visuals & Immersion
Experience the world with unparalleled depth and atmosphere.
* **Expressive Entities:** Uses Fresh Animations and 3D Skin Layers to breathe lifelike, fluid movement into players and mobs.
* **Atmospheric Audio:** Sound Physics Remastered, AmbientSounds, and Presence Footsteps provide realistic dungeon reverberation and dynamic environmental noise.
* **Visceral Combat:** EnhancedVisuals adds striking screen effects during intense combat encounters, pre-configured alongside Complementary Shaders - Unbound.

### ⚔️ Essential Wynncraft Utilities
Everything you need to conquer the endgame.
* **Wynntils & WynnAspects:** The definitive quality-of-life tools for tracking mythics, managing quests, and navigating the map.
* **Voices of Wynn:** Adds complete community voice acting to the server’s incredible questlines.
* **Spell Caster & Tooltips:** Simplifies combat with configurable macros, automated keybinds, and enhanced item details.
